meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,当你说出触发词,Claude 会获取当前 GitHub 仓库所有打开的 issue 和 PR,给每个条目分别派出一个后台分析任务,最后在 /tmp 目录里为每个条目写一份带链接佐证的报告。它全程只读,绝不会在 GitHub 上评论、合并、关闭或改动任何东西。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等词时触发。随后它会处理当前仓库所有打开的 issue 和 PR——无论多少个,全部逐个分析,一个也不跳过。

say.note: 为所有打开的 issue 和 PR 生成报告
只分析打开的 issue,不处理 PR
只分析打开的 PR,不处理 issue

howto.what_en: Claude scans all open issues and PRs in the repo, spawns one background quick analysis per item, and writes reports with GitHub permalink evidence to /tmp/. It is read-only: it never comments, merges, closes, or changes anything on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'. It then processes every open issue and PR in the repo — no sampling, no skipping, regardless of count.

say_en.note: Generates reports for all open issues and PRs
Analyzes only open issues, not PRs
Analyzes only open PRs, not issues
